thread:
Mia Patel: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we need to lock owners for the noise-reduction actions. TL;DR: threshold tuning, dedupe rule, paging policy changes, and a recurring-incident sweep. Who can own which?

Devin Lee: I can take threshold tuning for DB/replica alarms. Will run a baseline distribution analysis and propose new thresholds + a rollback plan by 2026-07-12.

Ashok Reddy: I'll own the dedupe/suppression rules. Plan to draft suppression logic and a small validation test harness; aiming for a PR by 2026-07-14. Need SRE to share the current dedupe config (link?).

PagerBot: Reminder: on-call rotation for 2026-07-15 week — Sam is primary, Julia is backup.

Sam Nguyen: I can do the paging policy edits and update the ops doc. Will reduce severity for flapping cache alerts to P3 and add a burst-suppression window. Target date 2026-07-18.

Julia Carter: I'll run the recurring-incident pattern sweep and produce top-5 noisy signals + suggested signal-pruning by 2026-07-13. Also will add a small eval set so we can monitor regressions after tuning.

Mia Patel: Thanks — consolidating action items here so we have a single source of truth: 
- Threshold tuning: Devin Lee (2026-07-12)
- Dedupe/suppression rules: Ashok Reddy (2026-07-14)
- Paging policy + docs: Sam Nguyen (2026-07-18)
- Recurring-incident sweep: Julia Carter (2026-07-13)
I'll create a short runbook for ownership handoff and set a 30m weekly check-in until these ship. Everyone please ack.

Devin Lee: :thumbsup: ack. I'll attach the analysis CSV once done.

Ashok Reddy: Ack — will drop PR link and the test script. Also, quick question: do we want to centralize dedupe rules in ops-config or keep per-service? leaning ops-config for visibility.

Sam Nguyen: :thumbsup: ack. I'll update the ops doc here: https://wiki.redwood.ai/ops/paging-policies and post the change in #incidents when merged.

Julia Carter: Ack. FYI two repeat incident clusters I flagged: cache-thrash on edge nodes and token-eviction spikes during model rollouts — will include examples in the sweep.

Mia Patel: Perfect. I'll create a kanban card in the Postmortem board and tag you all. If anyone hits blocker (access, infra, or policy), ping #eng-oncall or me directly. Closing the thread for now — will reopen when PRs/notes are attached. :white_check_mark:
